matrizFields.title: Budget Matrix entries
matrizFields.description: Each row becomes a budgeted value for the entity + cost center + account + year + month combination. An existing value for the same combination is replaced.

realizadoFields.title: Actual Expenses
realizadoFields.description: Each row becomes a new expense entry (existing entries are not replaced).

pacotesFields.description: Each row becomes a new package, always created as draft (the initial status cannot be set by the import).

receita.noProductsBody: Revenue is entered by Product. In Settings, create a hierarchy with code “produto” and add its items (levels allowed).

receita.selectEntityToEdit: Select an Entity to enter data or apply assumptions (consolidated is read-only).
receita.deductionsHint: Percentages over gross revenue, per product (taxes, returns, rebates).
receita.fxHint: Monthly rate to convert the currency to BRL (base currency). E.g. USD = 5.20.
receita.assumptionsHint: Applies a bulk adjustment to the selected Entity's existing entries.
receita.setupBody: Revenue is entered per product. List the products or services you sell and the system sets everything up.
receita.setupLabel: One product per line (or separated by commas)
receita.setupPlaceholder:
Product A
Product B
Consulting service
receita.setupButton: Add {count, plural, =0 {products} one {# product} other {# products}}
receita.setupHint: You can group them later in Settings > Hierarchies.
receita.unifiedHint: Type directly into the price and volume cells. Works like Excel: copy/paste (Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V), drag the small square to fill, Ctrl+D and Ctrl+R.
receita.noDeductionsHint: No deductions set. Configure them in the Deductions tab.
receita.periodEditHint: To enter values, switch back to Month.
receita.analysisHint: Calculated view (read-only): Gross revenue = Price × Volume; Net revenue = Gross − Deductions.
receita.prodAddPlaceholder: Names separated by commas or one per line
receita.prodDeleteBody: Delete {name}? Its entries will no longer appear.
receita.importIntro: Paste one or more columns from Excel, or choose a CSV/Excel file. The system trims extra spaces, ignores accents and case to find duplicates, and suggests a code for items without one. A Type column (Product/Service) is optional.
receita.importPastePlaceholder: Paste here. One line per product. With codes, use two columns: code and name.
receita.importNoRoot: Could not find the products root item.
receita.importCodeHint: Codes in italics are suggested by the system; you can edit them before importing. Customer codes from the sheet are kept. Existing products with the same code are renamed, not duplicated.
receita.editDiscardBody: You changed this item without saving. If you continue, the changes will be lost.
